## 简体中文

- 修复文件树刷新只更新当前目录、不更新已展开子目录的问题。底部刷新按钮、右键菜单刷新和 F5 现在都会重新读取当前目录及展开的子目录，显示服务器上外部新增、重命名或删除的文件。
- 目录折叠后重新展开时重新读取内容，并刷新其中仍处于展开状态的子目录，避免继续显示旧缓存。
- 刷新保留展开状态、现有文件选择和未保存的编辑内容；仅读取展开的分支，不递归扫描整个服务器目录。保留 v1.10.2 直接使用 `ZjDing42` 下载更新的修复。

## English

- Fix file-tree refresh only updating the current directory while leaving expanded subdirectories stale. The footer refresh button, context-menu refresh and F5 now reload the current directory and expanded descendants, showing files added, renamed or removed by external processes.
- Reload folders when reopened after collapsing, including descendants that remain expanded, instead of reusing stale cached listings.
- Preserve expanded folders, existing file selections and unsaved edits. Refresh only expanded branches instead of recursively scanning the whole remote tree. Retain the v1.10.2 fix that downloads updates directly from `ZjDing42`.
